title: Public mobile scan WhatsApp obscures fourth navigation action and loses brand green
root_cause: The public mobile four-action dock was introduced after the fixed-position WhatsApp components; the original widget retained a 14–18px bottom offset and sat above the dock at high z-index. Green appearance was not explicitly defended against later theme overrides.
impact: On 390px iPhone screen the floating WhatsApp circle blocks Mijn bedrijf in bottom navigation and appears dark rather than WhatsApp green.
fix: The existing public app CSS makes the canonical and legacy buttons #25D366 with a white icon, moves them above the dock with safe-area clearance, hides duplicates, and respects menus, consent and keyboard. Bump existing public stylesheet asset version; no extra router or widget.
prevention_rule: Whenever a public mobile fixed dock exists, assert real bounding-box separation (>=8px), official computed WhatsApp green, and clickable fourth navigation target at 320/390/820px, in the original website release path.
evidence: Original PR #6012 run 44268322760 rejected missing machine metadata; not a deployed release
outcome: Source fix pending protected CI, exact Netlify main READY and independent mobile DOM readback. No unverified LIVE claim.
